# Code Architecture
- Use a modular architecture to separate concerns and improve maintainability.
- Use Hexagonal architecture (ports and adapters) to decouple the core business logic from external dependencies.
- Use Solid principles to guide the design of classes and modules.
- Use Dependency Injection to manage dependencies and promote testability.
- Use red green refactoring to ensure that code is always in a working state and to facilitate continuous improvement.

# Code Quality
- Follow the SOLID principles to ensure that code is maintainable and extensible.
- Use descriptive names for variables, functions, and classes to improve readability.
- Write unit tests for all critical code paths to ensure that the code behaves as expected.

# Code Format
- Use Prettier to format code consistently across the project.
